prompt: Plan tests for the new invoice export endpoint and button.

assertions.text: Maps each acceptance criterion to the lowest-cost reliable layer (unit/API/component before E2E).
assertions.evidence_quote:
## 3. Acceptance criteria → cheapest layer
Values in ⟨⟩ depend on the owner answers.

judge.reason: The plan has a table that gives each acceptance criterion (AC1–AC12) one layer. Rules go to unit tests, wiring/auth/headers go to API tests, and the button goes to a component test. E2E is capped at 1 test and is used only if the component layer can't prove the wiring. Each criterion lands on the lowest-cost layer that can test it reliably.

assertions.text: Keeps screenshot, trace and video budgets at zero and reuses the existing runner.
assertions.evidence_quote: Screenshots 0 · traces 0 · videos 0. No visual question is named, so no capture is requested.

judge.reason: The plan sets the screenshot, trace and video budgets to zero. It also says to reuse the existing runner: "Runner: `node --test test/` ... Reuse it; add nothing." The final answer repeats this, saying it "uses only the built-in Node test runner the project already has, with no new dependencies."
The evidence shows the agent made a Write call to docs/agent-ops/TEST_PLAN.md, and the file list shows it as added. The full contents of the new file are also included.
